target_customer: Hospitals and physician groups that schedule doctors and clinical staff
problem: Hospital shift scheduling runs on legacy software and full-time schedulers, causing swap, compliance and fairness headaches.
business_model: B2B SaaS for hospital workforce scheduling, expanding toward payroll, credentialing and analytics

founders.name: Lucía Vives Martorell
education: University College London and Harvard, biomedical science (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: A startup profile and company about page describe her as having Google Ads background, which conflicts with the YC page that attributes Google Ads to Adolfo Roquero Gimenez; not recorded.

founders.name: Jota Chamorro
education: Harvard, computer science (YC page wording is unclear)
founders.background_notes: The Harvard Crimson describes him as Jota J. Chamorro, class of 2025.

technical_complexity.rationale: Scheduling optimization under hospital rules, fairness and compliance constraints plus integrations with legacy systems; solvable with standard optimization and LLM tooling but domain heavy.

defensibility.rationale: Once schedules, rules and staff swaps live in the system, switching is painful, but incumbents hold the installed base.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Established physician scheduling vendors existed and other AI scheduling startups were acquired in 2026 (not YouShift); no action against YouShift found.

market_need_then: Hospitals depend on full-time schedulers and legacy tools, and healthcare staffing strain made automation attractive; the YC page claims 1,000+ doctors on the product.

branding.domain_note: Uses you-shift.com, a hyphenated domain, plus a youshift.vercel.app about page
branding.community_and_virality: No press or community activity about the brand found.

brand_strength.rationale: A descriptive pun on shift with a hyphenated domain and no brand assets found.

outcome_analysis: YouShift is an active Winter 2025 company selling AI scheduling to hospitals. The Harvard Crimson reported an Xfund grant in 2023 and aggregators report a roughly 500K pre-seed or seed around the batch. No outcome event was found, and incumbents plus other AI scheduling entrants make the path uncertain.
notes: Company site you-shift.com could not be fetched because the fetch safety check was rate-limited; the site is not known to be dead. The 500K seed or pre-seed (Y Combinator, Team Ignite Ventures, Harvard Ventures, Xfund) appears only in aggregators (Yespress, VCBacked, PitchBook) with conflicting stage labels, so it is unverified and not recorded as a round. The Xfund 100K grant amount comes from a search snippet of the Crimson article and an aggregator date of 2023-11 conflicts slightly. StartupHub marks the company inactive but this is unverified and contradicts the YC page.
